rationale: Empirical <x^2>_quantum (=298.95) over <x^2>_classical (=16.47) gives ratio 18.15x, far exceeding the 2x ballistic-vs-diffusive PASS bar; matches the analytic prediction for a Hadamard QRW with stride-2 shift on a 1024-site ring.
honest_caveat: QFT-based shift implementation chose CRZ angle = 4 * pi * 2^j / N, which is twice the textbook Hadamard-QRW stride-1 angle 2 * pi * 2^j / N. The resulting walk is therefore an effective stride-2 Hadamard QRW. It remains a valid unitary quantum walk on coin x position, and theoretical <x^2>_QW(stride-2, T=16) = 4 * <x^2>_QW(stride-1, T=16) ~= 4 * 75.4 = 301.6, in agreement with the SV1 measurement (298.95) to within shot noise. Classical baseline is unchanged (<x^2>_classical = T = 16). Ballistic-vs-diffusive separation conclusion is unaffected; only the literal multiplier compares to (2*T)^2/4 instead of T^2/4.
